nodes.name: PageContent.tsx

nodes.name: PageContent

nodes.name: SystemFallbackPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides built-in maintenance, coming-soon, and not-found screens when no managed system page is available.

nodes.name: SystemModeFallbackPage
nodes.summary: Selects the built-in maintenance or coming-soon screen for the active system mode.

nodes.name: DefaultNotFoundPage
nodes.summary: Renders the project’s built-in not-found screen and homepage action.

nodes.name: page.tsx

nodes.name: generateMetadata
nodes.summary: Builds route metadata from the corresponding managed CMS page.

nodes.name: CmsPage
nodes.summary: Resolves a catch-all path through system modes, canonical homepage redirects, configured redirects, CMS lookup, and 404 handling.

nodes.name: not-found.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a managed 404 page when configured and falls back to the built-in not-found presentation.

nodes.name: NotFoundPage
nodes.summary: Loads the managed 404 page and otherwise returns the default not-found view.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Serves the configured homepage, applying system-mode fallbacks before rendering CMS-managed content.

nodes.name: generateMetadata
nodes.summary: Builds route metadata from the corresponding managed CMS page.

nodes.name: HomePage
nodes.summary: Applies system-mode behavior before loading and rendering the configured homepage.

nodes.name: pageData.ts
nodes.summary: Centralizes server-side Payload queries and metadata assembly for published pages, the homepage, and managed system pages.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses React cache-compatible server helpers and Payload depth controls to keep route data and metadata resolution consistent.

nodes.name: extractRelationshipID
nodes.summary: Normalizes scalar and populated Payload relationships into an ID.

nodes.name: getPageSettings
nodes.summary: Loads the page-settings global without populating relationships.

nodes.name: getSystemModeSettings
nodes.summary: Loads the system-mode-settings global used to control maintenance and coming-soon behavior.

nodes.name: getSeoSettings
nodes.summary: Loads global SEO defaults with media relationships populated.

nodes.name: getPublishedPageByID
nodes.summary: Fetches one published page by identifier at a caller-selected relationship depth.

nodes.name: getPageBySlug
nodes.summary: Fetches one published page by slug for direct lookup paths.

nodes.name: getPageByPathname
nodes.summary: Fetches a leaf page and verifies that its populated ancestry matches the requested pathname.

nodes.name: getPageByPath
nodes.summary: Joins route segments and resolves the corresponding published CMS page.

nodes.name: getHomepagePage
nodes.summary: Resolves the configured homepage relationship and loads its published page document.

nodes.name: getHomepagePath
nodes.summary: Returns the configured homepage’s non-root canonical path when one exists.

nodes.name: toManagedRouteMetadata
nodes.summary: Combines route-level SEO fields, global fallbacks, canonical URLs, Open Graph media, and robot directives into Next.js metadata.

nodes.name: toManagedPageMetadata
nodes.summary: Maps a regular page and its configured canonical path into managed route metadata.

nodes.name: getPublishedSystemPageByID
nodes.summary: Fetches a published system page by ID and optionally enforces its expected system-page type.

nodes.name: getSystemBehaviorPages
nodes.summary: Loads configured maintenance, coming-soon, and not-found pages for runtime system behavior.

nodes.name: getResolvedSystemPageRenderState
nodes.summary: Determines whether the current request should render or bypass a configured system-mode page.

nodes.name: getSystemPageRenderState
nodes.summary: Returns the active system-mode render state for a frontend request.

nodes.name: getHomepageRenderState
nodes.summary: Resolves homepage rendering while honoring system-mode overrides and bypass permissions.

nodes.name: getManagedNotFoundPage
nodes.summary: Returns the configured published not-found system page, if available.

nodes.name: getPageMetadataBySlug
nodes.summary: Loads a page by slug and converts it into Next.js metadata.

nodes.name: getPageMetadataByPath
nodes.summary: Builds metadata for a nested route, including active system-mode pages and configured redirects.

nodes.name: getHomepageMetadata
nodes.summary: Builds homepage metadata while honoring active system-mode pages.

nodes.name: RenderBlocks.tsx

nodes.name: getRenderableBlocks
nodes.summary: Removes null or unsupported entries from a page’s block list.

nodes.name: RenderBlocks
nodes.summary: Renders the filtered block sequence inside the shared page-block stack.

nodes.summary: Adapts a System Coming Soon Payload block into the dedicated coming-soon view with resolved actions.

nodes.name: SystemComingSoonBlockComponent

nodes.name: Component.tsx
nodes.summary: Adapts a System Maintenance Payload block into the dedicated maintenance view with resolved actions.

nodes.name: SystemMaintenanceBlockComponent

nodes.name: SystemMaintenanceView.tsx
nodes.summary: Composes the maintenance experience from shared status, copy, shell, and action primitives.

nodes.name: SystemMaintenanceView
nodes.summary: Builds the maintenance presentation from reusable system-page primitives.
